summary: E2E UI testing of P2 'Guardar resultados de Calculadoras' feature. All 6 requested flows PASS end-to-end against the public preview URL. Hub renders 10 module cards; Save dialog opens with full preview (1RM Promedio Ponderado 115.5 kg + 7 fórmulas); athlete & plan selects populated from real data (5 athletes, 1 plan for 'sds'); save persists via POST /api/calculator-results and toast 'Resultado guardado en el perfil del atleta' is shown; history toggle renders grouped-by-athlete view with the saved entry visible; validation 'Selecciona un atleta' fires when athlete is empty; DELETE removes the row. Test record TEST_QA_NOTA_AUTOMATIZADA was created and cleaned up.

issues: React hydration warning in console: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Source: /app/frontend/src/components/calculators/CalcShared.js Select component renders <option>{o.label}</option> but some o.label values are passed JSX nodes containing <span> (e.g., Carga y Fuerza module). Native <option> only accepts text. Fix: coerce o.label to string before placing inside <option>, or use a Radix Select. Low priority — no functional impact, but pollutes the dev console on every render of those modules.

action_items: (LOW) Fix '<span> inside <option>' hydration warning in CalcShared.js Select — ensure labels passed to native <option> are plain strings (e.g., String(o.label) or precompute). Currently triggers a React warning on every render of calculators that use this Select.
critical_code_review_comments: CalcSaveBar.js — clean, ~230 lines. Good data-testid coverage on every interactive element (calc-save-btn-{calc}, calc-save-dialog, calc-save-athlete, calc-save-plan, calc-save-note, calc-save-confirm, calc-history-toggle, calc-history, calc-history-row-{id}, calc-history-delete-{id}, calc-history-empty).
CalcShared.js — CalcResultContext + useRegisterResult pattern is elegant: BigResult registers as headline, MiniStat as item. Reset on every render keeps snapshots fresh. No memory leaks.
Native <select> in CalcShared.js Select is the only minor blemish; everything else uses shadcn/Radix Select correctly (athlete/plan selects in dialog).
Save dialog correctly disables Plan select until an athlete is chosen and filters plans by athlete_id — good UX.
History deduplicates via dedupe() and groups by athlete_name with collapsible groups — robust and tested.
